_comment: Briscola locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action token '[play X]', the card labels (A, 2..7, J, Q, K), the suit symbols (carried in the {card}/{trump_card} slots), or numeric counts/points/scores. The '(TRUMP)' marker text may be localized.

_slots.{trump_suit}: The trump suit symbol (♠♥♦♣) - do not translate
_slots.{trump_card}: The trump card label, e.g. '7♠' - do not translate
_slots.{card}: A card label, e.g. 'A♥' - do not translate
_slots.{max_pos}: The highest legal card position in the player's hand
_slots.{count}: The number of cards a player holds
_slots.{pos}: A card's position number in the hand
_slots.{points}: A number of points (card value or accumulated score)
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered score line, or the final per-player score block
_slots.{winner}: The player number who won the trick or game
_slots.{tricks}: A number of tricks won by a player
_slots.{deck_count}: Number of cards left in the deck

game.start: Tšwara ya Briscola e simolotse! Suti ya trump: {trump_suit} (Karti ya trump: {trump_card})

prompt.intro:
O raloka papadi ya Briscola - Mmoledi {player_id}.
Sepheo: Hlolela dikgato le kgobokanya diponto tse ngata (diponto tse 120 ka deck).
Diponto tsa Kareti: A=11, 3=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2, tse ding=0
Matla a Kareti: A > 3 > K > Q > J > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 2
Kareti tsa trump di hlola kareti tse sa trump ntle le matla.

Kgato: '[play X]' kapa X ke boemo (1-{max_pos}) ya kareti ka letsohong la hao

hand.empty: Ga go na dikarata tšeo di lego ka seatleng sa gago.
hand.trump_mark: (TRUMP) Ke be ke sa tsebe gore go tla direga eng.

trick.empty: Ga go na dikarata tšeo di ilego tša bapala leano leo.

turn.trump_info_deck: Maphasa a trump: {trump_suit} | Kareti e setseng ka deck: {deck_count}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Diriša [play X] moo X e lego boemo bja karata (1, 2, 3, bjalo-bjalo)
invalid_move.out_of_range: Sehlopha sa karte sa mofuta. O na le {count} dikarte (1-{count})

action.trick_win: Modiri {winner} o fenya trick ka {card} gomme a kwata {points} dipontsi!
